description: Keeps the main thread thin: a clearly multi-step / implementation-shaped Bash by the orchestrator (chained >2 steps, a heredoc, sed -i/tee, npm/cargo/make build, git commit/push, pytest/test runs) warns-then-blocks. A bare >/>> redirect is not implementation on its own. Read-only inspection AND sanctioned orchestration are never blocked, even chained: git status/ls/cat/grep/find, gh pr list/view/checks, gh run, gh api, `gh ship` (agent-tools#23), tg, review, git worktree list — the flapping fix (tg#5743). Subagent commands (agent_id present) are allowed. WARN first, BLOCK on repeat within ORCH_THIN_TTL_S (900s). Per-repo opt-out: agent_hooks.orchestrator_only:false in rig.yaml or RIG_ORCHESTRATOR_ONLY=0 (default ON). Escape hatch: ALLOW_ORCHESTRATOR_WORK=1 + ALLOW_ORCHESTRATOR_WORK_REASON='why', or inline `# orchestrator-ok: why` (pre-bash only). on_error=open.
